column5: Identified the exact checkpoint/config pair the pilot would use: DQN-QoE=experiments/results/offline_v2/qoe/seed256/dqn/offline_closed_loop/rep_0/checkpoint.pt, DQN-SLA=offline_v2/sla/seed256/... , both evaluated live under saclb_campaign_v2.yaml, differing only in --reward-mode. Arm-vs-arm this pair is a clean, matched comparison.

saclb_campaign_v2.yaml (both training-time and live-eval copies, byte-identical ratios) caps urllc at 4 raw PRB and mmtc at 3 raw PRB -- BROKEN verdict, entire configured range always below the scheduler's 5-PRB floor. embb's cap=12 clears the floor (MARGINAL). M43-P1B-1's live-offline replay across all 28 submitted seeds confirms urllc/mmtc floor-pinned 100% of steps, zero exceptions, regardless of policy action.

Stage 12 (same ClosedLoopKpmSource/saclb_campaign_v2* architecture family, n=600 held-out episodes across 6 checkpoints): offline held-out compliance has ZERO relationship to live compliance; per-step SLA margins offline were negative (violating) vs strongly positive live for the identical checkpoint. M27 (different offline-env lineage, cited as corroborating prior pattern): offline congestion_level capped 0.03-0.09 by construction vs live-measured 0.23-0.69.

Training env is multi-slice (all 3 slices simultaneously) but each slice's served/backlog is computed independently per (gNB,slice) from its OWN last ceiling -- no cross-slice capacity coupling term exists anywhere in the class. This is structurally incompatible with E4's confirmed live finding (embb served% down 6.6-13.1pts purely from urllc's co-located presence, via the real scheduler's cross-slice min_prbs subtraction).

finding_summary: CONFOUNDED, decisively. (1) Action-space exclusion: saclb_campaign_v2.yaml cannot produce a urllc ceiling above 4 raw PRB under any policy action -- E4's urllc regime (6-8) and urllc's own confirmed real band (M44-D) are structurally unreachable by either checkpoint under this config, not a soft risk. (2) Environment mismatch: both checkpoints trained against a KPM source already shown (Stage 12) to be live-uncorrelated and (by its own code) to model zero cross-slice coupling, while E4's regime IS defined by cross-slice coupling. Per the milestone's own instruction, NOT proceeding to PF2-1 on the current checkpoints/config. Retraining-plus-live-revalidation cycle scoped (not executed) in the doc's closing section. Awaiting go/direction -- a real timeline/rescoping decision, not resolved unilaterally.
